blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Filipino runner Cyril Cloyd Ongcoy lost his bronze-medal position after a jury overturned the disqualification of Uzbekistan’s Fakhriddin Khamraev at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games in Japan. Philippine delegation chef de mission Francis Diaz said he filed a formal manifestation after the men’s 1,500-meter T12/T13 results were posted Wednesday without indicating that an appeal was pending.
